text: phase A logical or temporal assembly of ECU Manager’s actions and events, e.g. STARTUP, UP, SHUTDOWN, SLEEP, etc. Phases can consist of Sub-Phases which are often called Sequences if they above all exist to group sequences of executed actions into logical units. Phases in this context are not the phases of the AUTOSAR Methodology.

targets.why: EcuM lifecycle startup, sleep, shutdown phases.
